No fix plan exists (HR-C10, HR-C11 and HR-F4 wait for the owner, O1-O3; PROMO-TX is fixed in WP-7 only if the primary run confirms it P1, WP7ADJ Q6): from / to are derived from the real fix diff and the entry moved into mutations[] then (mutsyntax-wp7.js --post-fix).
note: Judged by wp7-mutation-evidence.js --lists=fix against the post-fix baseline (exit 0, the fix's FIXES set). A fix entry names its rule (fixRule): the checker refuses a baseline whose FIXES[<rule>] is not set (NO EVIDENCE). Collateral names the reds a mutant's own path makes: the rule's CF check, decided after the fix, must read REJECTED and fails whenever one of its known answers reads today or wrong. Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-STAT,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-70 would also match an M-70b; WP-4's M-LOCK also M-LOCKa and M-LOCKb), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
